# <span id="aanchor401"></span> Exception Directory

## 5601 - 5603

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="05500">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5601 PFX - Duplicate prove import with different meter factor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="05500">

This exception is generated when a duplicate prove report is imported and the meter factor in the prove report being imported does not match the meter factor of the previously imported prove report.

For example: The previous prove report has a meter factor of ".998" and a new PFX file is imported with a meter factor of "1.02". The two meter factors do not match, so an exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="05501">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5603 PFX - Duplicate prove import with different product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="05501">

This exception is generated when a duplicate prove report is imported and the product in the prove report being imported does not match the product of the previously imported prove report.

For example: The previous prove report has a product of "NGL" and a new PFX file is imported with a product of "Propane". The two products do not match, so an exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="5604">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5604 PFX - Composite Meter Factor is missing from PFX file</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="5604">

This exception is generated when “Pressure Compensated” is Yes and the PFX file does not contain a composite meter factor. For example, if the meter characteristic “Pressure Compensated” is Yes, the application will attempt to import the composite meter factor (‘Composite MF’ in the Prove Report section) from the file. If the composite meter factor field is null then this exception is generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="5605">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />5605 PFX - Meter Factor is missing from PFX file</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="5605">

This exception is generated when “Pressure Compensated” is No and the PFX file does not contain a meter factor. For example, if the meter characteristic “Pressure Compensated” is No, the application will attempt to import the meter factor (‘Resultant Meter Factor’ in the Prove Report section) from the file. If the resultant meter factor field is null then this exception is generated.

</div>

</div>
